description: This file defines the StreamNotReadableException class within the ZipStream\Exception namespace. It is thrown when fread fails on a stream, indicating the stream could not be read.

classes.name: StreamNotReadableException
classes.description: An exception class that indicates a stream could not be read, used in the ZipStream library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new StreamNotReadableException with a message indicating the file that could not be read.
